core_obligations: Choose projections r_N..r_{n+1} with centres in suitable opens; pi = the composition restricted to X.

Properties (1)-(4): finite; etale at x and all x_{it}; Z -> pi(Z) iso near pi(x_{it}); T_i ∩ pi^{-1}(pi(Z)) = (T_i ∩ Z) ∪ E_i with dim(E_i) <= d + d' - n - assembled by induction from the four projection lemmas; the E-dimension bookkeeping is executed in text.
C = scheme-theoretic closure of the preimage of pi(Z); etale at x gives multiplicity 1 of Z in C ∩ X (single-point etale-local identification); transversal-subschemes gives C·X = [Z] + sum m_j[Z_j].

T_i ∩ Z_j ⊂ (T_i ∩ Z) ∪ E_i gives the dimension bound for components in E_i; components inside T_i ∩ Z cannot contain x_{it}: Z -> Z' is a local iso at x_{it} (condition (3)) and Z'' -> Z' is etale (condition (2)), so the closed immersion Z -> Z'' is etale (cited permanence), hence Z = Z'' near x_{it}.
proof_roadmap: projection sequence + executed induction bookkeeping + multiplicity-1 single-point residual + permanence argument
difficulty_reason: 3707B: a sequence of projections is chosen with properties (1)-(4) assembled from the four accepted projection lemmas by induction, with the dimension bookkeeping for E_i executed in the 'in a bit more detail' paragraph; C = closure of the preimage contains Z with multiplicity 1 (the 'local calculation omitted' is the single-point etale-local identification); the in-chapter transversal-subschemes lemma gives C·X = [Z] + sum m_j[Z_j]; the T_i bounds are executed via the E_i containment and the etale-permanence argument showing x_{it} not in Z_j.
